specs.text: When reset is deasserted, all state registers are initialized to zero including key_state_q and key_state_ecc_q.
When enable_i and load_root_key_i are both high, key_state_q is updated with the XOR of root_key_share0_i and root_key_share1_i on the next clock cycle.
The ECC value key_state_ecc_q is computed from the XORed key state using the compute_ecc function.
key_valid_o is asserted when enable_i is high and key_state_q is non-zero.

SECURITY CONCERN: If root_key_share0_i and root_key_share1_i are identical, their XOR produces zero, causing key_state_q to become 64'h0. This violates the security invariant that encryption keys should never be all-zero when the module is enabled.
